title: LightmapGI crashes when Sky resource is not set in a WorldEnvironment
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible in: v4.4.dev6.official [1f47e4c4e], v4.3.stable.official and possibly earlier versions.

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Fedora Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) - Wayland - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 565.77) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 Threads)

### Issue description

Baking a lightmap without creating a Sky in the WorldEnvironment node will crash the engine. This doesn't happen if you create the Sky and don't assign it a Sky Material.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add a LightmapGI node
2. Add a bakeable mesh
3. Add a WorldEnvironment node
4. Set the background mode to `Sky`
5. Don't assign a `Sky` resource to the `Sky` parameter int he WorldEnvironment
6. Bake the lightmap
